scope: Four figures rendered from selected historical precision/recall means; no manuscript change or new inference

figures.name: 01_motif_recall_precision
figures.caption: Archived Core K1/K2; 100 planned tasks per model/family/condition. Invalid outcomes contribute zero. Five families have six nodes; shaded Rhombus/Hourglass use four/five nodes and are not equal-size comparisons. Descriptive saved macro means; no uncertainty intervals or topology-causality claim.

figures.name: 02_size_recall
figures.caption: Archived Full Raw/Raw+E mean per-task recall; 100 planned tasks per model/motif/size/condition, with invalid outcomes zero. Raw+E adds facts. Sizes use different frozen task cohorts; fixed 25-candidate pools change target prevalence with size. All five variable-size families and three models are shown. No fitted size effect or uncertainty interval.

figures.name: 03_size_precision
figures.caption: Archived Full Raw/Raw+E mean per-task precision; 100 planned tasks per model/motif/size/condition, with invalid outcomes zero. Raw+E adds facts. Sizes use different frozen task cohorts; fixed 25-candidate pools change target prevalence with size. All five variable-size families and three models are shown. No fitted size effect or uncertainty interval.

figures.name: 04_condition_effects_recall_precision
figures.caption: Precision/recall differences are right-minus-left saved macro means in complete paired populations: 3,400 Raw pairs/model or 700 Core pairs/model. Invalid outcomes retain zero contribution; no validity-conditioned deletion. Unique designated facts are held fixed in presentation contrasts, but repetition/length/salience may change. No confidence intervals, significance or interaction test. Axes differ between intervention groups but are shared between metrics within each group.
